status: EXPLORATORY, POST HOC: computed after the holdout results and the human labels were known; the second judge is not in PREREG.md; no number here is confirmatory
disclosures: Post hoc: the second-judge run happened after the holdout results were known (PREREG.md register: no second judge or panel; 12.1 D1 records that the primary judge itself was switched without registration; D10 records G6 as not_computable for want of a second judge).

The AH labels (A) were adjudicated against judge-1-era material (the judge-1 evidence span and a Qwen draft; per_cell has draft_A, span_edited). pi-hat and L1* under judge 2 treat A as a judge-independent property of the (view, question) cell and inherit any judge-1 conditioning of A. Coverage computed on J alone does not use A.

The second judge was called without response_format=json_object (the local proxy rejects it) and with the proxy's default reasoning effort; temperature 0.0 was sent, but a reasoning model behind a proxy is not bit-reproducible (see run_manifest.json settings).
The A->B contrast and the variant ranking are descriptive here; PREREG sec.4 forbids reading differences below 0.53 L1 as ordered and forbids 'tie' language for unresolved contrasts.
